title: Bound Prometheus Eclipse
description: A surreal classical scene depicts a muscular male figure bound in glowing green vines lying on broken stone ruins, with blue energy emanating from his eyes and mouth. Two dark winged creatures fly above carrying chains of glowing blue symbols, set against a blood-red sky with a black eclipse sun, ancient Greek-style columns, a golden crystal formation, and a statue of a robed figure gesturing beside fiery braziers with floating runes.
